name: Twin Lovers
source:
It is a famous cultural festival in town held by all schools together. The night before the event main heroine confesses on the rooftop. Surprisingly, her feelings are accepted. Is this for real?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
这是全镇所有学校联合举办的一场著名文化节。活动前夜，女主角在天台上表白了。令人惊讶的是，她的感情被接受了。这是真的吗？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
